description.content: Machines & Files — one merged console: the machine list on the left drives a dual-pane file commander on the right (This PC ⇄ remote host), with Ping / Edit / Display / Drive redirection and the primary Remote action in the header toolbar.

File transfers over SMB: browse both sides, drag files across the divider or use the Send/Get arrows, with live progress, throughput and ETA in a persistent transfer dock (Queue + History). Cancel active items, one-click Retry on failures, and Skip is recorded.
Overwrite conflicts ask Replace / Keep both / Skip with an apply-to-all shortcut and both file sizes shown; Keep both writes name (copy).ext.

Fix: a Windows user-profile folder (C:\Users\<you>) no longer shows as empty — the special folders inside it (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, …) are marked System and were being filtered out; only hidden items are hidden now, matching Explorer.

Remote browsing rides the host's admin shares (C:\Users → \\host\C$\Users), and the remote pane opens straight in the user's home — C:\Users\{user} on Windows, the Samba home share on Linux/macOS. Unreachable shares explain exactly why (admin rights, SMB, credentials) instead of a generic not-found.
Automatic SMB sign-in: selecting a machine authenticates to its shares with the machine's DPAPI-stored credential (revealed only transiently) — no manual net use, no plaintext ever persisted.

One-click "Enable file access": after adding a Windows machine (or from its right-click menu) Deskpin can turn on the C$ admin-share policy remotely; for hardened workgroup local-admin hosts it copies the exact one-line command to run once on the box.
Per-machine operating system (Windows / Linux / macOS): Remote is disabled for macOS (no RDP server); Linux still connects over xrdp. The machine list shows live reachability and latency per machine.
Go-to-path address bar on both panes: click the breadcrumb, paste a path with \ or /, Enter to navigate — validated before navigating, with friendly empty-folder and access-denied states.
Drive redirection panel per machine (all drives, specific drives, hot-plugged) maps straight to the .rdp drivestoredirect field; turning it off honestly disables the Files console.
Report a bug from the Info tab — opens a pre-filled GitHub issue with optional diagnostics; no tokens stored in the app.
Real file logging at %LOCALAPPDATA%\RdpManager\logs (14-day retention) with an Open-logs-folder button, and toasts that auto-hide after 3 seconds.
Nocturne design system applied throughout: single blurple accent, outlined buttons, compact dark theme from one ResourceDictionary, with the RDP Manager monitor mark in the caption bar.

Security unchanged by design: passwords stay in DPAPI/Credential Manager, the generated .rdp never contains a secret, and the transfer engine, SMB sign-in and bug reporter hold no plaintext credentials.
